en-US.name: Spoken Letter
en-US.summary: Play the family stories delivered to your Spoken Letter account on your Echo.
en-US.description: Spoken Letter lets grandparents and relatives record family stories that are delivered to a family's account. Ask for the newest story, the story a storyteller sent, or the next one, and it plays on your Echo. Development stage only: this skill is tested on the Owner's devices and is not submitted for certification.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask spoken letter to play the story Grandpa sent
Alexa, ask spoken letter what is new

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development stage. Say: open spoken letter; play the story Grandpa sent; what is new; play the next one; pause; resume. Stories are the fixture recordings served from alexa.spokenletter.com.
